name: QIDI TPU-Aero @Creality CR-10 Smart
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 50 mm/s.
Product page: nozzle 230-270 C, bed 30-45 C (with glue), speed 30-50 mm/s, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, Vicat 70.4 C; hardness adjustable 85A to 65A via temperature/flow (e.g. 250 C, flow 0.68); page lists 'Density 0.74 g/cm3' which is the foamed printed part. Raw filament density 1.15 taken from older wiki table. Comparison guide: <100 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying required, no enclosure, annealing not recommended. Direct-drive only; disable retraction tuning expectations (stringing inherent). Not QIDI BOX compatible.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/tpu-aero
